metas.name: Parks and Recreation
metas.description: Matches the wholesome yet witty ensemble dynamic of Ted Lasso and Community.

metas.name: The IT Crowd
metas.description: A British cult classic that pairs perfectly with the tech-humor of Silicon Valley and the awkwardness of Peep Show.

metas.name: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
metas.description: A fast-paced, high-energy workplace comedy that matches the ensemble charm of Scrubs.

metas.name: Bob's Burgers
metas.description: A heartwarming family animation that captures the grounded, character-driven humor of King of the Hill.

metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description: Features the same dry, supernatural wit and ensemble absurdity found in Dirk Gently's Holistic Detective Agency.

metas.name: Taskmaster
metas.description: The ultimate lighthearted British reality show for fans of Gogglebox and British comedy personalities.

metas.name: Spaced
metas.description: A meta-heavy, pop-culture-obsessed British sitcom that paved the way for Community.

metas.name: Archer
metas.description: High-concept animated comedy that matches the sharp dialogue and genre-bending of Rick and Morty.

metas.name: Schitt's Creek
metas.description: A perfect 'comfort' show that evolves from cynical humor into a feel-good story like Ted Lasso.

metas.name: 30 Rock
metas.description: Delivers the rapid-fire jokes and satirical take on television production seen in Saturday Night Live.

metas.name: Arrested Development
metas.description: Features layers of hidden jokes and a highly dysfunctional family dynamic similar to It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia.

metas.name: Black Books
metas.description: A classic British sitcom focusing on a misanthropic lead, sharing the DNA of Peep Show.

metas.name: Solar Opposites
metas.description: Created by the co-creator of Rick and Morty, offering the same sci-fi chaos and high-concept animation.

metas.name: Fresh Meat
metas.description: From the creators of Peep Show, it offers a hilarious and cringe-inducing look at university life.

metas.name: Mob Psycho 100
metas.description: From the creator of One-Punch Man, it combines spectacular action with a very funny and sweet coming-of-age story.

metas.name: Derry Girls
metas.description: An incredibly high-energy, funny, and heartwarming ensemble comedy that is perfect for fans of New Girl.

metas.name: Better Off Ted
metas.description: A brilliant but short-lived satirical workplace comedy that mirrors the corporate parody of Silicon Valley.

metas.name: The Orville
metas.description: A sci-fi adventure that balances humor and heart, ideal for fans of Futurama and Doctor Who.

metas.name: Resident Alien
metas.description: A quirky sci-fi comedy about an outsider trying to fit in, fitting the tone of Fallout and Dirk Gently.

metas.name: Extraordinary
metas.description: A fresh British comedy about a world where everyone has superpowers except the lead, matching the wit of Brassic.

metas.name: Ghosts (UK)
metas.description: A charming, funny, and lighthearted ensemble comedy about a haunted house that is pure comfort viewing.

metas.name: Party Down
metas.description: A cult favorite ensemble comedy about catering workers that fits the 'unsuccessful group' trope of It's Always Sunny.

metas.name: Happy Endings
metas.description: A fast-talking, highly rewatchable 'friend group' sitcom that fans of New Girl will love.

metas.name: Venture Bros
metas.description: A deep-dive into sci-fi and superhero tropes with the same satirical edge as Rick and Morty.

metas.name: Spy x Family
metas.description: A wholesome and hilarious action-comedy anime that provides a great 'feel-good' experience.

metas.name: The Good Fight
metas.description: While a drama, its surreal humor and satirical take on modern life will appeal to fans of The Good Place.

metas.name: Stath Lets Flats
metas.description: A masterclass in British cringe comedy that will resonate with any fan of Peep Show.

metas.name: Our Flag Means Death
metas.description: A fun, uplifting, and comedic take on the pirate genre, similar in spirit to the adventure of ONE PIECE.

metas.name: Superstore
metas.description: An easy-to-watch workplace sitcom with a diverse cast and consistent laughs, perfect for background watching.

metas.name: Psych
metas.description: A lighthearted detective comedy with endless pop-culture references, perfect for fans of Scrubs and Community.

metas.name: How I Met Your Mother
metas.description: A classic 'hangout' sitcom that serves as a staple for light, comforting television.

metas.name: Kim's Convenience
metas.description: A warm, funny family sitcom that focuses on relatable everyday situations, much like King of the Hill.

metas.name: Star Trek: Lower Decks
metas.description: An animated sci-fi comedy that doesn't take itself too seriously, ideal for fans of Futurama.

metas.name: Abbott Elementary
metas.description: A modern mockumentary that is uplifting, funny, and incredibly easy to watch.

metas.name: The Great British Bake Off
metas.description: The ultimate 'relaxing' background show for when you need something purely positive.

metas.name: Gravity Falls
metas.description: A brilliant animated mystery-comedy that balances humor with a compelling, lighthearted adventure.

metas.name: Good Omens
metas.description: A delightful, comedic fantasy series with a great central duo, matching the energy of Doctor Who.

metas.name: Detectorists
metas.description: A quiet, beautiful, and very funny British comedy that is the epitome of comfort television.

metas.name: Mythic Quest
metas.description: A workplace comedy set in a video game studio, bridging the gap between Silicon Valley and Community.
